title: Contrix Member Delivery Binding Candidate
description: Builder-side candidate object that ferries Handle resolution output (intent=member_add | invite) or a trusted-issuer-signed equivalent into the Space member_add / invite pipeline. Produces a Space-scoped member_delivery_binding only after the reducer independently re-validates against Join Policy. See identity-handles.md §3.7.

subject_did.description: Principal DID of the addressee. Materialised as payload.actor_id / cell subject in cx.member.state{membership=join}.

handle_uri.description: Canonical contrix:// handle URI; lowercase localpart. acct:, bare host, or display strings are rejected here.

handle_aliases.description: Optional interop aliases (RFC 7565 acct:). Never used for cache keys, signature transcripts, or delivery_binding materialisation.

recipient_service_did.description: Principal Server service DID — source of member_delivery_binding.recipient_service_did once materialised.

binding_source.description: MUST NOT be did_document_default — handle-resolved candidates and DID Document fallback are independent materialisation paths.

issuer_service_did.description: Service DID that signed the candidate (Directory service DID, Principal Server service DID, or Organization service DID).

audience.description: Target Space DID or inviting service DID. Verifier MUST reject candidates whose audience does not match the current invocation context.

expires_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp. Expired candidates MUST NOT enter the builder.

issued_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp marking when the issuer signed the candidate. Required: paired with expires_at to give verifiers a replay-protection window and to detect retro-dated candidates. issued_at MUST be <= expires_at.

source_refs.description: Event references at the issuer / Directory / Organization that back this candidate; clients SHOULD re-verify against the truth source.

proofs.description: At least one proof binding handle_uri, subject_did, recipient_service_did, audience, issuer_service_did, issued_at, expires_at and (when present) claim_digest. issued_at MUST be inside the signed transcript so an MITM cannot widen the replay-protection window by rewriting it; verifiers MUST reject proofs whose canonical transcript omits issued_at.

claim_digest.description: sha256 digest of the upstream handle claim canonical JSON; used as cache key and audit-chain anchor.

intent.description: Builder entry point. Advisory for audit / telemetry; reducer behaviour does not branch on this field.
